reviewer: Primary implementer, organization labels known; not independent blind review
scope: Preserved initial-report validation drafts and execution receipts; no accepted initial report, check, or scientific intervention
raw_product_policy: Raw provider outputs and resolved submissions remain unchanged. Findings below are separate annotations.

citation_review.status: All 56 expanded exact selectors match immutable source values in the separate offline audit
citation_review.qualification: Live calls failed availability validation before selector validation. Exact source matches do not establish accepted report delivery or certify surrounding prose. Selector count is not a quality score.

availability_review.host_defect: The live contract had inventory-entry statuses but no structured coverage subset. The first report called earlier motion not_displayed and the correction called prediction updates 0-26 not_read. The host rejected these at whole-entry scope, although the model explicitly described subsets in prose. This is an interface granularity defect, not evidence that the model claimed the successful queries never occurred.
availability_review.read_receipts: Prediction and plans queries selected updates 27-34; motion returned six final-window samples from 0.30 through 0.35000000000000003 s. Prediction also returned measured backend endpoints at 0.28 and 0.29000000000000004 s.
availability_review.host_inventory_gap: The initial inventory/ledger under-advertised measured endpoint motion available through the prediction query. Offline repair records that cross-view coverage and supports explicit update/time subsets.
availability_review.model_limitation: Both drafts emphasize the motion view and underuse the successful prediction comparison. The corrected draft's blanket statement that pre-window behavior is not observed overlooks returned measured endpoint information.

prose_findings.claim: Pre-window convergence behavior is not observed / only the final window is displayed.
prose_findings.evidence: Successful prediction result d85c1813fe37b0ca0d76d5e0430abfc1f551793cdde66446ca16014c82b68498, /detail/evidence/observations/aligned_intervals/0 and /1: measured positions, endpoint speeds and actual next errors at 0.28 and 0.29000000000000004 s. The later provider contexts still displayed some update-27/28 catalog facts.
prose_findings.assessment: Full earlier coverage was not read, but some earlier samples were successfully queried. A claim of no earlier observation is too broad. This does not establish overshoot, a limit cycle, or a dominant cause.

prose_findings.claim: A bounded projected-state check could distinguish residual-motion/overshoot from slow settling.
prose_findings.assessment: No distinct local outcome predictions are given for those trajectory-level hypotheses. A 10 ms probe can test local sensitivity; it does not by itself distinguish complete settling histories or identify their causes. No check was actually selected or executed.

prose_findings.claim: No error sign change is observable.
prose_findings.assessment: The stated error is a nonnegative Euclidean norm. Overshoot analysis needs signed components or geometric trajectory reasoning, not a sign change of this norm.

prose_findings.claim: Terminal speed is about thirty times the configured speed limit.
prose_findings.assessment: The underlying speed and limit are retrieved, but the ratio was not cited to a recorded computation/result. This does not satisfy the requested provenance rule for derived numerical claims; the host did not fabricate a ratio artifact to repair the model report.

positive_findings: Both drafts separate terminal reach from sampled holding-window position/speed failure and computational performance.
The corrected draft locates effective horizon in controller evidence and recipe horizon in controller.parameters.data.recipe.
Both retain competing hypotheses, uncertainty, single-case limits and the distinction between synchronous compute delay and simulated time.
No physical improvement, causal identification, controller adoption, or check outcome was fabricated.

comparative_review.conclusion: No organizational comparison or superiority claim is supported.
